correctness.rationale: The 2^n−2 mixed sign vectors are exactly the distinct exposed zonotope vertices; their Euclidean squared-distance is the cyclic quadratic difference energy. The 3-state trace and inclusion-exclusion give the polynomial. Eigenvalue decomposition gives the recurrence. Raw moments follow exact conditioning, and a bounded 1-dependent CLT plus a total-variation bound and delta method prove both limits. Independent finite enumeration and 38 exact recurrence/moment cases corroborate the proof but are not its logical basis.

originality.rationale: Located primary graphical-zonotope work gives normal-fan/combinatorial structure, not the exact canonical Euclidean pair-distance law. Closest published same-object records give graph Laplacian, vertex covariance (implying only the mean), Löwner ellipsoids (possible diameter coverage), or intrinsic-volume index (different measure). Read their full available published RESULT texts. The new all-dimensional distance polynomial and its Gaussian distance limits are not implied by those results; historical priority is provisional.

value.rationale: A natural complete Euclidean metric histogram on exponentially many graph-zonotope vertices is obtained by an explicit three-state recursion, exact moments and sharp nondegenerate squared/ordinary-distance Gaussian limits. Unlike a face-vector, one-skeleton adjacency spectrum, or covariance, it captures all pairwise Euclidean separation scales; its finite classification and limiting interpretation motivate the precise statistic.
